packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/__in.name: Trading package
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/__in.description: Marks the trading code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/acco.name: Signed-authority check
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/acco.description: Checks an agent holds a valid signed authority over the account, covering this market and action, before any money action.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/acco.name: Account snapshot
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/acco.description: Reads an account's balance, open positions and orders from the broker as one snapshot.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/admi.name: Risk admission
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/admi.description: At the point of trading, blocks new risk while the broker's facts are uncertain, and always lets a position be reduced or closed.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/agen.name: Execution door check
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/agen.description: The authority check just before a trade is sent: the agent's mode and standing instruction as they are now, and an exact match to the owner's approval.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/appr.name: Approval drift
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/appr.description: Ends a trade approval if the price has moved out of its band since it was shown, and wakes the agent.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.name: Manage a broker account
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.description: Carries out the owner's broker-account changes from chat: switch on or off, disconnect, change the password or token, and start the account running again.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.name: Connect a broker account
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.description: The multi-step job that sets up, starts and connects a trading account from chat, cleaning up anything it created if a step fails.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.name: Broker reconciliation
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/brok.description: Re-reads an account from the broker, matches outside changes to the agent responsible, and wakes it.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/clos.name: Closed-trade wake
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/clos.description: When a trade closes, wakes the agent that owned the position with the trade's facts, including its result in units of its starting risk, so it can write a short self-review.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/clos.name: Closed-trade ledger
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/clos.description: Keeps one record per trade that fully closed at the broker, linked to the order and judgment that opened it.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/conn.name: Broker identity & connect
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/conn.description: Verifies a broker account's identity and creates the connection and its stored credentials together.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/deci.name: Decision readiness
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/deci.description: Keeps the model's judgment, the detector's observations and the execution state separate when deciding whether a trade is ready.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/dele.name: Account delegation check
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/dele.description: Refuses an action on an account the agent is not allowed to act on.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/exec.name: Execution quality gate
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/exec.description: The final set rule for how an order will be filled.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/exec.name: Execution service
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/exec.description: The one place a trade is actually sent, after every authority, risk and run-integrity check passes, recording a receipt.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/expo.name: Account exposure
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/expo.description: Works out the exact per-symbol exposure on an account, without inventing currency conversions.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/idem.name: Trade fingerprints
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/idem.description: Builds the fingerprints and ids that stop the same trade being sent twice.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/inst.name: Price formatting
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/inst.description: Formats a price to an instrument's number of digits.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/jour.name: Trade journal
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/jour.description: Records the typed facts of each trade at the moment it is sent — never the model's reasoning or secrets.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/manu.name: Manual-activity detection
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/manu.description: Spots trading done by the owner or someone else at the broker, by comparing broker facts, and attributes it to an agent where it can.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/morn.name: Morning brief
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/morn.description: Builds Lonora's once-a-day brief: it learns the owner's usual time, gathers broker-confirmed facts, and folds in the weekly reports.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/oper.name: Operation lifecycle
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/oper.description: Records each owner-visible step of a money operation, only from the durable record, never guessed from a broker reply.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/oppo.name: Opportunities engine
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/oppo.description: Keeps a trading thesis up to date and links it to the trades that act on it, waking the agent on meaningful changes.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/owne.name: Owner attestation
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/owne.description: Lets the owner formally confirm an uncertain operation; it never re-sends the trade.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/owne.name: Ticket ownership
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/owne.description: Works out which agent owns a trade ticket, and the broker facts a request is checked against.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/perf.name: Performance snapshot
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/perf.description: Reads an agent's results from broker-confirmed closed trades.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/pict.name: Account picture
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/pict.description: Builds the up-to-date picture of each account an agent gets on every wake: positions, exposure, owners and floating profit.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/posi.name: Position sizing
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/posi.description: Works out a read-only trade size from the account's current, exact broker economics.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/pref.name: Trade preflight
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/pref.description: The checks a trade must pass before it is sent.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/real.name: Realized profit
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/real.description: Works out realized profit and loss from the broker's own deals.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/reco.name: Operation reconciliation
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/reco.description: Recovers the true outcome of a trade whose sender stopped mid-way, by reading broker evidence — it never re-sends.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/retc.name: Broker reply normalizing
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/retc.description: Turns the broker's raw reply codes into a consistent form.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/runt.name: Broker health
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/runt.description: Checks a broker connection is responding.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/simu.name: Import simulation
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/simu.description: Brings in imported simulation data for an account.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/stat.name: Trade statistics
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/stat.description: Works out an agent's results from broker-confirmed closed trades, grouped by kind of judgment, instrument, session or side: wins out of how many, money, and results in units of starting risk, for the agent alone or for the whole team.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/targ.name: Target-state receipt
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/targ.description: Concludes an uncertain management action from the broker's current state, never by re-sending.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/tick.name: Ticket transfer
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/tick.description: Moves a deleted agent's open positions and pending orders to Lonora, and wakes Lonora about them.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/trad.name: Trade results in risk units
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/trad.description: Works out a closed trade's entry and exit prices, its first stop and target, and its result in units of the risk it started with, from the broker's records; when that can't be known it says why instead of guessing.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/veri.name: Effect verification
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/veri.description: Separately confirms a trade actually took effect at the broker; it never sends or retries.

packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/week.name: Weekly report
packages/trading/src/lonora_trading/week.description: Wakes every agent once per trading week to write its report of that week.
